name: Wushoolay the Storm-Witch
notes: Numbers follow the Wushoolay section of docs/research/zul-gurub/edge-of-madness.md: 293,150 HP (Era), 31,440 mana, level 63, 20-man. No cadences are published: Chain Lightning, Forked Lightning, Lightning Cloud and Lightning Wave intervals are estimates. Boss melee (280 per 2 s) is scaled so a 10,000 HP tank survives normal play and dies if the healer ignores a spike. The real raid's central job is draining his 31,440 mana so Chain and Forked Lightning stop; the engine has no mana, so this cannot be modelled, and the lightning simply continues all fight, which makes this script harsher than a well-drained real fight and easier to pass than an undrained one. Chain Lightning is a 1.5 s interruptible cast that hits a frontal cone of 15 yd (its jumps and escalating damage cannot be expressed): whether Chain Lightning is frontal is an open question (Wowhead yes, wiki/DBC no) and this script takes Wowhead's reading. Forked Lightning is an instant cone. Lightning Cloud: `hazard` at a random player's feet, 10 yd, 1 s warning, 15 s, 200 Nature per second; Lightning Cloud's numbers could not be verified: BW tracks 26550 (657 to 843 every 3 s), DBM and warcraftdb 24683 (875 every 5 s), and the script's 200 per second sits between them. Lightning Wave is a one-tick debuff on a random player. Melee reach is 7 yd and a harmless rear cone (nothing uses it) puts melee on his flank, so they can stand just clear of a cloud's edge and still hit him.

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Face him away from the raid so only you take the lightning, and walk him out of each Lightning Cloud. Nature Resistance is assumed.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Stay strictly behind him (Chain and Forked Lightning go forward), walk out of every cloud, and interrupt Chain Lightning when you can.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Stay spread behind him, out of the frontal cone. Interrupt Chain Lightning when you can and walk out of clouds.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Tank focus: lightning bursts hit the tank fast. Stay behind him, spread, and out of the clouds.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment the boss turns on the raid, never while it is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

interrupt.label: Interrupt
interrupt.tip: Chain Lightning is a 1.5 s cast that hits everyone in front of him. Kick it when you can.

chainLightning.label: Chain Lightning
chainLightning.tip: A 1.5 s cast: 875 Nature, jumping to nearby players with rising damage. Interrupt it and stay spread.

forkedLightning.label: Forked Lightning
forkedLightning.tip: An instant frontal blast. Only the tank should be in it.

lightningCloud.label: Lightning Cloud
lightningCloud.tip: A cloud under a raid member: 463 Nature and then 875 every 5 s for 15 s within 10 yd. Move out at once.

expectations.label: Pull him away from the raid
expectations.tip: Taunt him and walk him to the middle, facing away from the raid.

expectations.label: Keep him facing away from the raid
expectations.tip: Chain and Forked Lightning go forward. Point them at nothing but you.

expectations.label: Stay out of the clouds
expectations.tip: Lightning Cloud does more than most boss abilities. Move out now.

expectations.label: Stay out of his front
expectations.tip: Melee behind him. Ranged and healers spread at the back.

expectations.label: Interrupt Chain Lightning
expectations.tip: A Chain Lightning you stop is a whole raid not jumped.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Lightning bursts are the danger. Keep the tank above them.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Do not let the tank sit low between lightnings.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the ground effect before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

cues.notes: Interrupt Chain Lightning, Heal the tank.

list.label: Taunt when Wushoolay turns on the raid
list.tip: Taunt as soon as the boss turns toward the raid.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: The tank is below half health and a big hit is coming. Heal now.

list.label: Interrupt Chain Lightning
list.tip: A 1.5 s Chain Lightning has started. Interrupt inside the cast.

drills.name: Pull and face away
drills.description: Pull him and hold him facing away while lightning goes off.

drills.name: Step out of clouds
drills.description: Clouds every few seconds. Step out, keep attacking, and kick Chain Lightning.

drills.name: Lightning tank healing
drills.description: Keep the tank alive through forward lightning.

limitations: Lightning Cloud and Chain Lightning use simplified targeting. The chain does not jump between nearby players.
